observation: A sequential successor-draft helper appended a valid decision and improvement proposal, then attempted to append an already-used event ID. Per-ledger duplicate protection correctly rejected the event write, but the earlier cross-ledger writes remained committed.
root_cause: Schema-aware append is atomic per target ledger, not transactional across a multi-ledger orchestration. The caller also selected an event ID without preflighting the global event ledger.
resolution: Preserve DEC-0023 and IMP-0013 because they are valid intended successor records, record this execution defect, and append the successor event under the next unused stable ID.
regression_disposition: No new v0.07 product regression. REG-0011 already proves duplicate IDs fail closed within a ledger. Cross-ledger transaction/preflight support is deferred as reliability work (aligned with roadmap v0.12-v0.13) and should receive a dedicated regression when that capability is introduced.
